On 12/08/2010 11:59 PM, Saptarshi Guha wrote:

I removed rhlapply. I should update the docs. The effect of rhlapply
can be replicated

given rhlapply(1:N, F) i.e compute F(i) for i=1,..N

M = expression({
F=function(....){

}
lapply(map.values,function(r){
rhcollect(r, F(r) )
})
})

z=rhmr(map=M, N=N,
inout=c("lapply","seq"),ofolder="/tmp/outputfolder",mapred=list(mapred.reduce.tasks=0))
rhex(z)


It is wordy, but it is boilerplate and you can replace it using
quote/bquote/substitute and R's lisp style macro functions

Saptarshi
